item.text: The CSV writer joins fields with commas without quoting them, so `Acme, Inc` becomes two columns. Contact names avoid this because the exporter already replaces their commas with semicolons. I’ll preserve that behavior and add CSV escaping for commas, quotes, and line breaks.

item.text:
Fixed CRM-284. CSV fields now correctly escape commas, quotes, and line breaks, so `Acme, Inc` stays in one field and records retain four columns.

Existing contact-name formatting and formula protection are preserved. All five tests pass, including the new regression coverage.
